paragraphs: A seat may contain partitions that divide the storage space without revealing the floor under each support. The lid may open into one compartment while a fixed partition separates another base area. The provider will retain that difference in the evaluation record and explain any useful panel release. A construction choice to rebuild the storage feature more extensively will have its own client approval rather than silently change the treatment scope.
